title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: unified alert queue with Triage Agent categorisations
summary: The briefing passes: the control paths, licensing, rollout facts and documented privacy exception are supported. It correctly flags the conflicting retirement dates; a minor correction should also acknowledge Microsoft's differing descriptions of the agent's running identity.
